correctness.rationale: The 2x2 nearest-neighbor exclusion transfer matrix yields exact cycle and marked-point trace identities. Explicit rational cumulant factorization has one sign-controlling polynomial H_m. Its limits, endpoint derivatives, and exact evaluation at t=1/2 prove strict opposite extreme signs and the alternating sign at lambda=2. C1 convergence H_m to 2t-1 on [2/5,3/5] ensures a unique local root for all sufficiently large m; Taylor expansion yields the stated uniform O(m4^-m) location. Standalone rational exhaustive independent-set enumeration passed 64 cross-checks, but the infinite statement relies on the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Three-site connected response is a natural collective observable beyond two-site covariance. The theorem gives a nontrivial rigorous sign reversal for every periodic system of lengths 3m+1, a parity-sensitive exact test at one common physical activity, and the universal parity-oscillating exponentially small location of a local crossing at large size. This is a quantitative global loop-correction law, not a mere re-expression of the finite cycle partition polynomial. It is deliberately limited to this structured family; no thermodynamic singularity is claimed.
